messages:
mei-ml: Quick RFC follow-up: we need a clear split of ownership for low-bit support (FP8/INT8/4-bit). Who owns (A) runtime negotiation schema, (B) compatibility matrix, (C) validation prompt set and (D) rollback/playbook? Need consensus today.

carl-eng: My vote: runtime schema = Platform, compatibility matrix + ops playbook = Ops, validation harness = ML. Reason: runtime needs a tiny stable contract; ops handles which profiles go live and rollouts.

sanjay-platform: I can take the runtime handshake. We should keep the handshake minimal: a profile_manifest token that proves runtime+profile match, not weights. Example manifest (YAML):
```
profile_id: qp_manifest_v1
precision: FP8
manifest_hash: sha256:abcd...
signature: sig:v1-xxxx
compat_tier: experimental
```
Platform will expose a read-only /handshake endpoint returning this token.

lisa-pm: Product constraints: automatic fallback to a higher-precision profile within 200ms for user-facing failures or quality regressions. If fallback rate >2% sustained for 15m, page SRE. Need those thresholds codified.

carl-eng: Rollout checklist (draft):
- CI unit + perf tests
- Canary: 0.5% traffic with watchdog evals
- Extended canary: 5% for 30m, check quality signals
- Ramp to target with staged gates and auto-fallback
- Emergency: immediate revert to previous profile or route to CPU-hosted high-precision variant

ops-bot: Created issue infra/quant-ops/1 "init compat matrix CSV + playbook" assigned to ops-oncall. CSV cols: model,model_tag,profile_id,manifest_hash,validated_on,validation_score,stage,owner

mei-ml: On validation: ML will own canonical prompt sets and metric definitions (LLR delta, embedding cosine, hallucination heuristics). Platform will host the canonical bundle in a versioned bucket and provide signed URLs. ML must publish a validation report with a pass/fail flag.

sanjay-platform: Also calling out secrets: manifest metadata (profile_id, manifest_hash) is public; model hashes may be sensitive. Platform will support signed manifests where necessary and flag fields that must be redacted for external consumption.

carl-eng: Owners (tentative): runtime handshake & schema = @sanjay-platform; compat matrix + ops rollout = @ops-oncall; validation harness & prompt corpus = @mei-ml; playbook docs + checklist = @carl-eng (to hand off to Ops).

lisa-pm: Add alert thresholds to playbook: LLR drop >0.03, embedding cosine drop >0.02, UFE (user-facing error) increase >0.5%. Pre-deploy sign-off from ML + Platform required. Also tag Security for KMS/HSM implications for signed manifests.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. We'll draft the ops CSV and an initial playbook template. Ops will also add rollout automation hooks to trigger immediate routing changes if thresholds are hit.

mei-ml: I'll push the first prompt-set PR today and include example validation artifacts. Will mark it WIP and tag @sanjay-platform for the signed URL.

sanjay-platform: I'll open the handshake schema PR with small Python + Go examples for parsing the manifest token. Plan to land a staging branch by EOD.

carl-eng: I'll append a short appendix to the RFC summarizing owners, the handshake schema snippet, and the rollout checklist. Targeting EOD tomorrow for circulation.

lisa-pm: Thanks all. Please treat ownership above as the decision unless objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
